description: Get the regions/cities subtree under one area id (e.g. 113=Russia) — lighter than the full /areas tree.

area_id.description: Country/region id to fetch the subtree for (e.g. 113=Russia, 1=Moscow). Lighter than the full /areas tree.

raw.description: Return the full raw hh.ru JSON instead of the compact id — name listing.

name: get_areas_subtree
